nodes.v: A first visit that actually tells you something

Most "new patient" offers buy you a rushed look and a quote. This one includes the diagnostics — digital imaging and an OralID screening — so the plan you leave with is based on what is actually going on rather than what is visible from the doorway.
One of the doctors talks you through it personally, answers your questions, and sets out priorities. No upselling: the practice's reviews say so more convincingly than we can.
